name: Suproclone
summary: Suproclone is a sedative and anxiolytic drug in the cyclopyrrolone family of drugs, developed by the French pharmaceutical company Rhône-Poulenc. Other cyclopyrrolone drugs include zopiclone, pagoclone and suriclone. Suproclone is very similar in structure to the related drug suriclone, but little information has been published about it specifically.

uses.text: Suproclone is a sedative and anxiolytic drug in the cyclopyrrolone family of drugs, developed by the French pharmaceutical company Rhône-Poulenc.

pharmacology.en: Like other cyclopyrrolones, it is thought to boost the calming effect of GABA at GABA-A receptors, acting near the benzodiazepine binding site.
pharmacology.zh: 與其他環吡咯酮類藥物一樣，它被認為會在GABA-A受體上增強GABA的鎮靜作用，作用位置靠近苯二氮平結合位。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与其他环吡咯酮类药物一样，它被认为会在GABA-A受体上增强GABA的镇静作用，作用位置靠近苯二氮平结合位。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related drugs such as zopiclone can cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。佐匹克隆等相關藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題與依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。佐匹克隆等相关药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题与依赖。

fact.en: It is a cyclopyrrolone, the same chemical family as the sleeping pill zopiclone, and was developed by the French company Rhône-Poulenc.
fact.zh: 它屬於環吡咯酮類，與安眠藥佐匹克隆同一個化學家族，由法國羅納普朗克公司開發。
fact.zhHans: 它属于环吡咯酮类，与安眠药佐匹克隆同一个化学家族，由法国罗纳普朗克公司开发。
